scoring_guidance: Compare level and relevance of academic qualification with the vacancy. Do not infer professional registration from a degree title.
Compare stated teaching subject/subject combination with the vacancy subject.
Score relevant secondary-school teaching experience against the vacancy minimum and preferred experience.
Look for lesson planning, learner-centred methods, classroom management, assessment and practical teaching evidence.
Identify explicit teacher education or professional teaching training. Verify registration separately where required.
Compare additional skills that are relevant to the subject and school context.
